subject.title: feat: node-hosted plugins — dynamic tools, MCP servers, and skills

question: Should existing paired nodes automatically gain default-on authority to publish model-visible tool metadata and full skill instructions after upgrade?
rationale: Tests can prove command, connection, and payload enforcement, but only maintainers can choose whether pairing alone is the intended long-term authority for this new model-context surface.

options.title: Make publication opt-in
options.body: Default the gateway node tool and skill publication settings off, preserving existing upgrade behavior until an operator enables the new authority.

options.title: Approve default-on trust
options.body: Treat node pairing as sufficient publication authority and explicitly accept the upgrade impact documented by this PR.

options.title: Add separate approval
options.body: Require an additional publication approval or policy while retaining node pairing for command-family execution.

recommendation.title: Make publication opt-in
recommendation.body: Default the gateway node tool and skill publication settings off, preserving existing upgrade behavior until an operator enables the new authority.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged history across the affected node, plugin, MCP, and skills architecture and is best positioned to decide the intended trust model.
